{{Quote|This is mining facility AG3-T of the Mensix Mining Company. Our world is rich with many resources that are considered to be desirable in numerous systems throughout the galaxy. We Mustafarians have made a very comfortable living supplying those systems.|[[Urup Fal'co]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TS">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|The Strike|Mustafar}}</ref>}}
The '''Mensix Mining Facility''', formally known as '''mining facility AG3-T''', was the largest mining installation on the planet [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. It was built by [[Mensix Corp]] near the [[Klegger Corp Mining Facility/Legends|Klegger Corp Mining Facility]] destroyed at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
{{Quote|The problem is that this facility was built based off of the old Klegger station, which was built during the days of the Old Republic. No one manufactures power rods for technology that old anymore.|[[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Chivos]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SoD">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|Salvage or Die|Mustafar}}</ref>}}
The mining facility AG3-T<ref name="SWG:TS" /> was located in the [[Mining Fields]]<ref name="SWG:TMFM" />, a region of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] that was the primary operating area of the Mensix Mining Company.<ref name="SWG:MF">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=poi|Mining Fields|Mustafar}}</ref> The massive mining complex was built on the side of a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]], overlooking a large [[Magma/Legends|lava]] river.<ref name="SWG:MMF2">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=poi|Mensix Mining Facility|Mustafar}}</ref>

[[File:Mensix_Mining_Facility_droids.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A Mustafarian miner working alongside mining droids]]
The Mensix Facility was the headquarters and the main mining facility of Mensix Corp.<ref name="SWG:MMF2" /> It was nearly an identical replica of the older [[Klegger Corp Mining Facility/Legends|Klegger Corp Mining Facility]],<ref name="SWG:TMFM" /> and even used the same technologies dating back to the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]].<ref name="SWG:MMF" /> The mining facility possessed three massive collector arms that were used to collect large amounts of molten rock from the lava river. A giant centrifuge then processed this magma to extract the valuable ores from the lava.<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> The Mensix Mining Facility could process almost five thousand metric tons of raw materials harvested from the rich lava flows every day.<ref name="SWG:MMF" /> The facility was the central hub of activity on its continent of Mustafar.<ref name="SWG:MMF2" />

[[File:Mensix_Mining_Facility_miners.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Mensix Corp miners chatting in a corridor of the facility]]
The mining facility was also used as a planetary [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].<ref name="SWGTCGPOGG">[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> The main level of the facility was opened to the public and could be directly accessed though the landing pad that was served by extra-system space [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]]. The main level included the Mensix Corp command center, a conference room, a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], a medical bay, several offices and various technical rooms.<ref name="SWG:MMF2" />

==History==
{{Quote|I am sure that you have noticed that we are experiencing many different problems here. It is of the utmost importance that we find a way to quickly upgrade this facility so that we can stay on schedule and meet our clients' demands.|[[Milo Mensix]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TDS">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|The Downed Ship|Mustafar}}</ref>}}
The Mensix Mining facility was built shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="SWG:TMFM" /> At the end of the Clone Wars,<ref name="SWG:MMF" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> the [[Klegger Corp Mining Facility/Legends|Klegger Corp Mining Facility]] was [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|destroyed]], leaving [[Klegger Corporation]], the most important mining company on Mustafar bankrupt.<ref name="SWG:MMF" /> Fortunately, [[Milo Mensix]], a local Mustafarian corporation executive, was able to salvage the assets of Klegger Corp, preventing the mining business on the planet to fall apart.<ref name="SWG:TDS" /> This allowed the [[Mensix Mining Company]] to take over as the primary mining corporation on Mustafar and build its own facility,<ref name="SWG:MMF" /> in the neighborhood of the ruins of the Klegger Corp Mining Facility.<ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=The Shadow Syndicate|cardname=Mustafar Diorama}}</ref>

[[File:Mensix_Mining_Facility.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Mensix Mining Facility during the Galactic Civil War]]
Around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], staff of the mining facility, all Mustafarians, included [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Chivos]],<ref name="SWG:SftM">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|Supplies for the Miners|Mustafar}}</ref> Surveyor [[Jo Keslev]],<ref name="SWG:TMFM" /> [[Urup Fal'co]],<ref name="SWG:TS" /> [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Armstrong]],<ref name="SWG:MM">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|Miner Madness|Mustafar}}</ref> Foreman [[Donko Jen]],<ref name="SWG:qwertz">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|Clear Out Beetle Nest|Mustafar}}</ref> Chief [[Ulon Glost]],<ref name="SWG:TMe">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|The Man-eater|Mustafar}}</ref> and [[Milo Mensix]] himself.<ref name="SWG:TDS" /> Other people working in the facility included the [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeologist]] [[Ithes Olok]],<ref name="SWG:SoCGD">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|Symbols of Chu-Gon Dar|Mustafar}}</ref> the geologist [[Pwwoz Pwwa]],<ref name="SWG:Bags">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|Being a good samaritan|Mustafar}}</ref> the [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Epo Qetora]],<ref name="SWG:Ahl">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|A history lesson|Mustafar}}</ref> and the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Menddle]].<ref name="SWG:DH">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|Destroy HK-47|Mustafar}}</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] got envious of to the rich production of the Mensix Mining Company and even considered to [[Imperialization/Legends|take over]] the company. After the Battle of Yavin, the Galactic Empire forced Milo Mensix to make the Empire his main client and requested more that what his company could produce. As the Empire threatened to subjugate Mensix Corp if he did not meet the imposed deadlines, Milo Mensix pushed his staff and machinery to work over capacity.<ref name="SWG:TDS" /> The mining facility was solicited to process 20 percent more materials than normal, causing damage to the equipment.<ref name="ToOWPoI">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Trials%20of%20Obi-Wan%20Points%20of%20Interest|text=Trials of Obi-Wan Points of Interest}}</ref> Finally, a wide strike of the mining crews erupted<ref name="SWG:TS" /> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> and made the situation even more complicated for the company.<ref name="SWG:TS" />

[[File:Mensix_Mining_Facility_Milo.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Milo Mensix's crisis center during HK-47's droid revolution]]
Foreman Chivos therefore recruited a band of spacer to deal with several immediate problem for the company, including repairs of the mining facility.<ref name="SWG:SftM" /><ref name="SWG:RAF">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|Replace Air Filters|Mustafar}}</ref><ref name="SWG:SoD">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|Salvage or Die|Mustafar}}</ref> Afterwards, the desperate Milo Mensix tasked the spacer with exploring the wreckage of an [[Unidentified Hammerhead-class cruiser|Old Republic cruiser]] in order to find lost technologies that could be used to improve the mining facility.<ref name="SWG:TDS" /> In the crashed ship, the spacers discovered the [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|artificial intelligence]] of a droid trapped in a computer.<ref name="SWG:TTotA">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|The Transfer of the AI|Mustafar}}</ref> This AI belonged in fact to the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[HK-47]]. The droid had been intentionally confined in a common computer by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] twenty years before because it was too dangerous.<ref name="SWG:TTwH">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|The Trouble with HK-47|Mustafar}}</ref> HK-47 tricked the spacers into helping him to escape the ship's computer. The droid claimed that he could help Mensix Corp to find the wanted technology if they transferred his memory to the computers of an old [[Old Research Facility|research facility]],<ref name="SWG:TTotA" /> and then to an abandoned [[Neimoidian droid factory|Separatist droid factory]] on Mustafar. The spacers accepted and followed HK-47's instructions.<ref name="SWG:WPWT">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|Wrong Place, Wrong Time|Mustafar}}</ref> However, they later realized that they inadvertently allowed HK-47 to begin the production of a large [[HK-47's Droid Army|droid army]]. Furious at having been stuck in a crashed ship for two decades, the assassin droid wanted to take revenge by destroying all [[Species/Legends|organics]] on the planet. The spacers returned to the Mensix Mining facility as quickly as possible to warn Milo Mensix that the mining complex was the main target of HK-47's droid army. The Mustafarians had limited defensive capabilities but they fought heroically and, thanks to the decisive intervention of a large group of spacers hired by Milo Mensix, they finally [[Battle of Koseyet|defeated]] the droid army at the [[Koseyet Mining Camp]].<ref name="SWG:TTwH" /> Eventually, HK-47 and the remnants of his army were defeated in an epic [[Battle in a volcano crater|battle]] in a volcano crater. After the conclusion of HK-47's droid revolution, Mensix Corp took control of the old Separatist droid factory with the intention to sell the resources stockpiled there to the Empire, and eventually to be released of the Imperial menace.<ref name="SWG:DH" />

[[File:Mensix_Mining_Facility_cantina.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The cantina]]
Around the same time, in 1 ABY,<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] piloted by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Diskret Stahn]] was attacked by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] while traveling to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The ship escaped but was severely damaged, forcing Captain Stahn to make a detour to Mustafar. The pilot landed at the Mensix Mining Facility for repairs and supplies. Unfortunately, Diskret Stahn and his passenger, the [[Entertainer|dancer]] [[Pei Yi]], had to wait for a very long time because the repairs were considerably delayed. Hence, they spent most of their time in the mining facility's cantina.<ref name="SWG:DS">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=conversation|Diskret Stahn|Mustafar}}</ref><ref name="SWG:PY">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=conversation|Pei Yi|Mustafar}}</ref> Other beings who visited the facility in the meantime included [[Uggo]],<ref name="SWG:Tcs">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|The cursed shard|Mustafar}}</ref> the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[Q4P3]],<ref name="SWG:Acb">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|A collector's business|Mustafar}}</ref> and the treasure hunters [[Menth Paul]]<ref name="SWG:Tcs" /> and [[Ikt]].<ref name="SWG:TSS">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|The Serpent Shard|Mustafar}}</ref> Later the same year, a spacer who explored the facility collected a [[lava cannon]].<ref name="SWG:RHW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Heavy Weapons}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Mensix Mining Facility appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MMF2" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Mensix Mining Facility were added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] on [[November 1]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:MMF2" />
